newsitem.title: USA: American Management, SRA get $12 mln navy contract.
newsitem.headline: American Management, SRA get $12 mln navy contract.

text.p: SRA International Inc said Monday the General Services Administration Federal Systems Integration and Management Center has awarded SRA International Inc had awarded it a contract to provide enterprise information systems software support services to the Navy Maintenance Support Office (NMSO).
NMSO performs complete life-cycle development for maintenance depots with the Department of the Navy. The contract, said SRA, has an estimated value of $12.5 million over five years.

SRA said it and and its team member American Management Systems will support NMSO in providing information systems to users within the maintenance depot hierarchy, ranging from business process analysis through post-installation support and life-cycle maintenance.
SRA is a systems integrator that focuses on national defense, health care management, civil government, law, telecommunications, financial services, media and international markets.
